<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>Transport rate limit exceeded - message rejected</span></div>

## Why it happens

The tenant profile limits how many messages the tenant, each device and each gateway may send per second. The log line's `exceeded_by` says which limit was hit.

## Fix it

- Have the device send less often. A value every 100 ms is rarely needed.
- Or ask the system administrator to raise the rate limits in the [tenant profile](/docs/user-guide/tenant-profiles/#rate-limits).

## Check that it worked

The log shows no new rejections.
